notes.title: One Year Anniversary!
notes.notes:
Hi detectives,

Happy one year anniversary of Death Trick: Double Blind!

This has been a long year for us and we have been busy since, but this is a good time to look back at this game. 

It was our first time creating a game world and characters from scratch, turning them from silhouettes to character sprites, to animations and CGs; turning them from vague age and job descriptions to fully fleshed-out characters with their own backstories, desires, fears, and hopes. We weren't just writing a case, contradictions and alibis, but also all the minor, memorable moments in their lives: the pebbles that sunk into the water, the ostrich racing on the highway, the doodles on a set of tarot cards, the engravings on the old puppet sealed away into a box... And the end of a golden era.

During the two and half years of production for this game, we spent every waking moment with these characters in our heads. And it might sound a little silly, but they felt incredibly real to us. I found myself doing things like sending a vintage outfit video to Jenny saying "Hattie!", or coming up with a silly pun and immediately yelling out, "Chip!"

By the time we finished the game, it was like these characters had become my dear friends, and releasing the game felt like a goodbye to them. And going back to this game again feels like a melancholic reunion. We know they will always exist-- if only briefly, on the screens of every player who decides to jump into the story.

When we were making this game, we often imagined and joked about who they'd become in this modern era: where they'd be, what clothes they'd be wearing. So, here's a little Modern AU art for you all. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for playing Death Trick: Double Blind.

Best,
Mari & Jenny

notes.title: Check out the demo of our new project: Zero-Sum Heart
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This is Mari & Jenny, the developers of Death Trick: Double Blind!

We have a little update: Jenny & I developed Death Trick: Double Blind under Misty Mountain Studio, but after DTDB's release, we decided to form a studio of our own: Citreat Studio! 

For the past few months, we've been working on a new short project: Zero-Sum Heart, which now has a demo and a release date! Check out the trailer here: 

[previewyoutube=oaFPrwco4DU;full][/previewyoutube]

Zero-Sum Heart is a romantic thriller visual novel about a girl who makes a deal with the witch to sacrifice her heart in exchange for love. We are excited to explore different genres and styles, and will always be focused on telling interesting character stories. Please go check out the demo on our steam page and wishlist it: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954920


What does this mean for Death Trick: Double Blind? The plan has always been that it will be a stand-alone piece of story, with no DLC or sequels. Thank you all so much for the support and feedback for the game, and we will continue to work with Misty Mountain Studio and Neon Doctrine to support Death Trick: Double Blind post-release. 


Follow Citreat Studio's developer page: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Citreat/

Follow us on Twitter: https://x.com/CitreatStudio

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/SCVFr2nNaj

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.16.2
notes.notes:
[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed a bug where the "Master Logician" Achievement could not be unlocked if have previously failed the deduction sequence
- Fixed a bug where Rolf's Yan-as-a-crow comic would re-appear and get stuck on screen upon multiple saves and loads with an on-screen comic panel.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.16 [Moving locations no longer costs AP]
notes.notes:
[Design Change] 
- Following player feedback, after some consideration, we made it so that moving location in the game *no longer* costs AP. We hope this will make gameplay smoother and give you the chance to explore more stories in the game!

[Changes]
- Following the AP change, tutorial has been changed accordingly, and slight changes have been made to the 10am Moses scene to accommodate for more actions. 

[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed a bug where the sunset background was incorrectly displayed for the Fair scene when the player ends 12:00 Detective scene in Fortune Teller or Big Top
- Fixed a bug where opening and quickly closing the map will leave the scene silent without BGM
- Fixed minor typos in English
- Fixed wrong controller button instructions for log on the bottom right of the controller UI
- Disabled resizable window to prevent resolution issues

notes.title: Magician's Costume Design Contest!
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to Backstage! [/h1]
The circus performers are busy getting ready to wow in the big top, and our Mechanic Alys is hard at work designing a costume for the mysterious new magician… 

Starting from today, we are running a [b]Costume Design Contest[/b] for Death Trick: Double Blind! 

Entries close: 23rd January 9AM CST
Voting Ends: 23rd January 4PM CST

We want members of the community to [b]design individual parts of a magician's costume (Hat, Dress, Boots)[/b] and everyone to vote on their favorites in each category.

[h2]RULES[/h2]
1. Design a piece of our magician's costume: [b]Hat, Dress, or Boots.[/b]
2. [b]Submit an image[/b] of your design to the "Backstage" Channel in our [url=https://discord.com/channels/293120529030840330/1161948347523928117]Discord[/url] .
3. You are allowed [b]up to three entries[/b], one for each piece of the costume. 
4. React with the 🎩 Emoji on the costume pieces you think should be used for the [b]final design[/b]. 
5. [b]Give a compliment[/b] to one of the other entries
6. Top voted design in each category will be put together to create an outfit for our magician!

[i]Submissions can be created in any medium; drawn, painted, sculpted, photoshopped etc.[/i]
[h2]COMMUNITY VOTING[/h2]

notes.notes:
Join us from [u][b]May 25-31[/b][/u] for an exciting weeklong celebration of women in gaming as [url=https://theindiehouses.org/][b]The Indie Houses[/b][/url] proudly presents the Women in Gaming Steam Event, in collaboration with [url=https://www.gmgsf.org/]Girls Make Games[/url]. This event aims to support the Girls Make Games Scholarship Fund and empower the next generation of game creators.


During this event, we will showcase over 60 incredible games that feature women-led development teams and/or female protagonists. Prepare to immerse yourself in captivating experiences from studios such as [i]Kaigan Games[/i], creators of the acclaimed [i]SIMULACRA [/i]series; [i]Keybol Games[/i], the brilliant minds behind [i]Jack Axe[/i]; and [i]GameChanger Studio[/i], the masterminds behind the hauntingly beautiful [i]My Lovely Wife[/i] and [i]My Lovely Daughter[/i] and of course [i]Death Trick: Double Blind[/i] from us!


Throughout the event, you'll have the opportunity to explore demos and enjoy special discounts on a wide selection of titles. In addition, we've dedicated a section on the event page to Girls Make Games, where you can learn more about their impactful work and discover the incredible games that girls have created through their program.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2254710/Death_Trick_Double_Blind/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43435838/aacfaedc7be70642a8593b67359fd4ac3f267cca.png[/img][/url]

A portion of the proceeds earned by each publisher during the event will be donated to the Girls Make Games Scholarship Fund. This fund combines professional development and financial support, ensuring that underrepresented students have early access to STEAM programs and the opportunity to thrive.

Girls Make Games has been providing an inclusive space for girls and non-binary students to explore the world of video games since 2014.
